newsitem.title: USA: Pearson's Penguin USA unit named in suit.
newsitem.headline: Pearson's Penguin USA unit named in suit.

text.p: Penguin USA, a unit of Pearson Plc, was added as a defendant in a lawsuit filed against Dove Audio Inc alleging fraud and breach of contract regarding royalties on the book, "You'll Never Make Love in This Town Again."
The suit was first filed November 14 in Superior Court on behalf of Liza Greer, one of the book's four authors.

"The complaint alleges Penguin USA and Dove falsely claimed only 150,000 books were sold as of June 30, 1996 and that less than $1.5 million in net receipts has been earned as of that date," Rick Rosenthal, attorney for Greer said.
Officials of Dove and Penguin declined comment.
